result.summary: The street features a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides, but lacks traffic control signals or signs. A major safety hazard is present due to a large utility truck parked directly at the crosswalk, which severely obstructs sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A large utility truck is parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers and vice versa.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, at the start of the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent vehicles from parking in a way that obstructs the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban street with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. A large service truck parked at the corner creates a major visual obstruction, significantly reducing safety at the crossing by blocking sightlines.
